Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That`s why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimageable with us.

Who You Are

As a Data Engineer, you’ll play a pivotal role in enabling efficient data access, analytics, and value generation across a global Science & Technology enterprise. You’ll build and maintain data pipelines that bring data from diverse sources into a cloud-based analytics stack, working closely with business partners for data cleaning and preprocessing. Partnering with Data Governance and Quality teams, you’ll ensure data aligns with FAIR principles and implement reusable components and infrastructure to streamline future use-cases.

You’ll be part of a dynamic team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge analytics solutions across Healthcare Data and Analytics function. This role offers a unique opportunity to expand your expertise across various technical, scientific, and business domains, enhancing your Data Engineering skills within a project-based, multi-domain environment.

• M.Sc./PhD/BE in Computer Science or related field with 2+ years of relevant experience.
• Proven experience with cloud platforms (e.g., Palantir, AWS, Hadoop) and data security best practices.
• Strong experience in Python, PySpark, R, and familiarity with additional programming languages (e.g., C++, Rust, Java).
• Skilled in designing ETL architectures for batch and streaming processes, database technologies (OLTP/OLAP), and SQL.
• Experience in Apache Spark, Hadoop ecosystem, and multi-platform/cloud setups (AWS, GCP, Azure).
• Knowledge of data governance, GxP data contexts, and familiarity with the Pharma value chain is a plus.
• Agile mindset with a proactive, hands-on approach and experience in leading teams.

Your Role

Work collaboratively with a Data Architect and Engineers to design and manage reliable, secure data pipelines, and cloud-based analytics architectures. Support data governance, gather requirements, and establish best practices with business and IT stakeholders to build a cohesive data framework for optimized decision-making and innovation.

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We celebrate all dimensions of diversity and believe that it drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of our diverse team!

LiveRamp is shaping the future of responsible data collaboration between the world’s leading brands, retailers, financial services providers, and healthcare innovators. As consumers embrace new AI-driven experiences, the LiveRamp data collaboration network exponentially expands the breadth and accuracy of the data on which marketing AI capabilities operate, powering deeper customer insight and measurable performance on a global scale. LiveRamp is headquartered in San Francisco, California, with offices worldwide. Learn more at LiveRamp.com.

Position Overview

LiveRamp, Inc. is seeking an experienced Senior Financial Analyst, FP&A to support our strategic financial planning and analysis initiatives. In this critical role, you will partner with cross-functional teams—including Finance, Operations, and Business Leadership—to deliver actionable insights, enhance forecasting processes, and support data-driven decision-making that drives the company’s growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop, maintain, and enhance financial models to support budgeting, forecasting, and long-term planning initiatives
• Analyze financial results, identify trends, and provide variance explanations comparing forecast to actuals
• Collaborate closely with business and functional leaders to understand growth drivers and cost structures
• Design and deliver clear, comprehensive reports and presentations for executive leadership
• Drive improvements to business processes, reporting automation, and data integrity across FP&A functions
• Support strategic initiatives with robust scenario and sensitivity analyses
• Assist in the annual budgeting process as well as regular financial reforecasts

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; MBA or relevant certification a plus
• 4+ years of progressive experience in financial analysis, planning, or related roles (technology sector experience preferred)
• Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial modeling; experience with planning systems (e.g., Adaptive Insights, Anaplan, Hyperion) strongly preferred
• Demonstrated ability to analyze large data sets and translate complex findings into actionable recommendations
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present to senior stakeholders
• Strong collaboration skills, proactive mindset, and attention to detail

Benefits

• Competitive salary and performance-based bonus
• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
• Flexible work arrangements and generous vacation policy
• Opportunities for ongoing learning, professional development, and career advancement
• Inclusive, innovative, and supportive company culture

If you are passionate about financial strategy, enjoy building strong business partnerships, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you. Join LiveRamp, Inc. and help shape the financial future of our business!

We use automated decision systems (ADS) as part of our recruitment and hiring process. If you require an accommodation or believe that the use of an ADS may create a barrier to your application or participation in the hiring process due to a disability or other protected characteristic, please let us know. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations and ensuring an equitable hiring experience for all candidates.

To all recruitment agencies: LiveRamp does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, LiveRamp employees or any other company location. LiveRamp is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Role Profile: Senior Software Engineer Fullstack

        Experience: 5 - 8 Years

        Location: Pune / Mumbai

        Reporting To: Project Lead

        Required Skillset: Insurance Domain, React.js , Node.js , Next.js, JavaScript, HTML, Spring Boot, Postgres and Microservices.

Role Overview

The Senior Software Engineer will be a key hands-on developer dedicated to building and executing tasks across the enterprise integration capability and API ecosystem. In this role, you will be responsible for translating technical specifications into clean code, delivering assigned tasks across critical insurance domainsincluding the Policy Administration System (PAS), Claims, Accounting, Reinsurance, Ancillary Systems, and External Third-Party Integrations.

This position requires strong hands-on coding expertise in Java/Groovy, Spring Boot, and Microservices architectures, React.js/Node.js/Next.js, JavaScript, Java and development tools. Work experience of Insurance domain and InsureMO platform is highly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

        Core Engineering & Middleware Execution

Drive end-to-end integration delivery by designing, coding, configuring, and deploying modular components using Spring Boot Microservices. You will develop robust integrations that route cleanly through the enterprise middleware framework to avoid point-to-point hardcoding, while strictly adhering to enterprise API design standards and clean-code practices.

The role requires ability to understand and utilize InsureMO platform capabilities and configuration tools, including iComposer, iHub, and other relevant InsureMO components, to configure, customize, orchestrate, and integrate insurance products and services. The developer should be able to leverage platform capabilities wherever applicable rather than implementing functionality through unnecessary custom code.

        Core Platforms & Third-Party Ecosystem

Consume and extend vendor APIs to map complex data structures and handle platform customizations, with a specific focus on the cloud-native InsureMO ecosystem. You will build high-performing REST APIs to seamlessly connect vital third-party utility servicesincluding KYC/CKYC, VAHAN, IIB, and Payment Gatewaysensuring secure backend support for modern React/JavaScript digital channels.

        Testing, Automation & Collaboration

Secure flawless production rollouts by building and running comprehensive automated test collections using the Postman tool suite for SIT/UAT phases. In this collaborative role, you will partner closely with onboarding managers and QA engineers to resolve technical dependencies and rapidly troubleshoot post-go-live incidents

Required Experience & Technical Skills

• Total Experience: 58 years of hands-on experience in software development, with experience in backend development, frontend development, and system integration.

• Core Backend: Proven experience in backend development using Java, Groovy, Spring Boot, and Microservices architecture.

• Database: Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL.

• Frontend: Proficiency in frontend development using Java, JavaScript, React.js. Experience with Node.js and/or React.js/Next.js is preferred.

• Integration & Testing: Strong understanding of REST APIs, messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ or Kafka, and API testing using Postman.

• Domain & Platform: Prior experience in the Insurance domain is required. Hands-on experience with the InsureMO platform, particularly platform customization and integration, is preferred.

Educational Qualifications

• Bachelors degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

• Certifications in Spring Boot, Java, or cloud technologies (AWS/Azure/GCP) are a strong plus.

Success Measures

        Follow software development life cycle.

• Adhering to schedule and on-time delivery of assigned projects, API features and integration.

• Performance, sub-second latency, and low error rates of written code in production.

• Rapid identification, debugging, and resolution of defects during SIT/UAT.

• Low post-go-live technical incident volume and minimal defect leakage.

• Active contribution to maintaining clean documentation.

febc11bb7ff9aedb.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

Why This Role Matters
As Camunda grows past the $100M ARR mark, we are building the marketing infrastructure to define and lead the Business Process Orchestration and Automation (BOAT) category. Our ability to tell a clear, compelling, and consistent story — across products, solutions, and personas — is critical to that mission.

This Director sits at the intersection of product and solutions marketing: one part platform storyteller, one part GTM architect. Reporting to the VP of Solutions Marketing & Strategic Communications, you will own the narrative for key areas of the business, lead cross-functional execution, and mentor a portion of the team. This is not a pure IC role, and it is not a pure people manager role. It is both — and the balance will shift as the business scales. We are looking for a strong player/coach mentality with the experience to coach through that daily participation.

What You'll Be Doing
Own the Narrative
• 
Serve as an outcomes-first minded storyteller for your product and/or solutions areas. Translate complex platform capabilities into clear, differentiated value propositions that land with C-suite buyers, LOB leaders, and technical practitioners alike.
Lead the Solutions or Product Marketing function
• 
Own positioning, messaging, use cases, competitive intelligence for defined areas.
Drive Go-to-Market
• 
Lead GTM strategy and execution launches in your area. Coordinate across sales, marketing, and product to ensure the message lands in the market — and sticks.
Arm the Field
• 
Feed the enablement engine so our sales, system engineering, partner and customer success counterparts win: pitch decks, battle cards, demos, technical papers, solution briefs. Content that works in the room, not just on a slide.
Influence the Market
• 
Support analyst relations strategy with Gartner and Forrester along with other social influencers. Ensure the firms that shape enterprise buying decisions understand what Camunda is, where we lead, and where we are headed.
Develop the Team
• 
Manage and mentor your team. Set the standard for output quality, coach toward it, and build a culture where high standards and deep collaboration are the baseline — not the aspiration.
What You Bring
• 
10+ years in B2B enterprise software marketing, with at least 5 years in a senior individual contributor or people manager role spanning product marketing, solutions marketing, or both.
• 
Global experience evidenced by knowledge of how culture, communication and buying behaviors vary by region, enabling local Field & Partner teams with the right approach for them
• 
A demonstrated track record of creating and marketing solutions that solve complex business problems — not just positioning product features.
• 
Strong storytelling instincts and the ability to simplify highly technical concepts without losing precision or credibility.
• 
Experience in a technical domain: automation, AI/ML, developer tools, integration (iPaaS), middleware, or adjacent spaces.
• 
Proven ability to lead GTM execution and orchestrate successful launches in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.
• 
Exceptional cross-functional skills — history of partnering as an equal with Product, Engineering, and Sales without relying on authority.
• 
Executive presence and communication skills. Comfortable engaging with C-level customers, analysts, and internal leadership. A compelling event speaker.
• 
Experience managing or mentoring marketers — either directly or through project-based leadership.
• 
Ability and willingness to use Camunda's product. Comfort building with and alongside AI tools is expected at this level.
• 
Understanding of the GSI, RSI, cloud hyperscaler and ISV ecosystems, and the development of joint value propositions
Nice to Haves
• 
Direct experience in process automation, orchestration, BPM, or the BOAT space.
• 
Experience marketing to both highly technical (developer) and senior business (LOB, C-suite) personas simultaneously.
• 
Analyst relations experience with Gartner, Forrester, or similar firms.
• 
Experience in a high-growth, remote-first company navigating category creation.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 

For more information, visit WPP.com.

Why we're hiring:

As a Data Engineer in the WPP Enterprise Data Group, you will be responsible for the design and implementation of scalable data solutions providing enterprise-scale data transformation across a broad range of projects.

Your role will focus on delivering solutions that utilize large-scale data ingestion, processing, storage/querying, streaming, and batch analytics using Databricks. As part of a team, you will implement world-class solutions designed by our data architects. Your responsibilities will include estimating, designing, coding, testing, deploying, and ensuring scalability and performance on Azure using key technologies like Databricks.

As a hands-on technologist with an extensive data engineering background using Databricks, you will be joining a group of Data Engineers who are passionate about building the best possible solutions for our business and endorse a culture of life-long learning and collaboration.

What you'll be doing:

• Design, build, test and maintain data pipelines (ELT), according to business and technical requirements.
• Implement secure platforms with data governance in mind.
• Play a key role in automation and building industry leading solutions against architectural best practices.
• Propose technical designs and develop integrations.
• Deliver data migrations between legacy & modern platforms
• Design & deliver data warehousing solutions and key data engineering workstreams for any required solution.
• Support cross-functional teams across the data space.

What you'll need:

Minimum requirements for this role include:

• 3+ years of experience designing and building scalable distributed data pipelines and dimensional data models
• 3+ years of experience in Python and SQL
• Experience using Databricks platform and PySpark is a must.
• Extensive experience of Microsoft Azure data services – Data Factory, ADLS gen2, Event Hubs, Azure SQL, Azure Key Vault
• Ideally experience in the following – Kafka, Delta Lake, Pandas
• A demonstrable understanding of Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and Agile practices, unit & integration tests and development practices using Azure DevOps.
• Fluency in English.
• Exposure to AI & ML technologies is a plus.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.
